findings.evidence: Lines 97–104 expose the definition and state only its representation projection. The established pattern at `RepresentationTheory/LinearCharacter.lean:149–158` keeps the analogous `FDRep.of` wrapper opaque and exports `ofLinearCharacter_def`; `Standard.lean:137` and `RealForm.lean:320` likewise use `(rfl)` specifically to preserve opacity.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]`; replace `spechtModuleℂ_ρ` with an opaque object-level equation `spechtModuleℂ μ = FDRep.of (Representation.baseChange ℂ (spechtModule μ).ρ) := (rfl)`, and derive representation/action facts by rewriting with it and `FDRep.of_ρ'`.
findings.issue: `spechtModuleℂ` is `@[expose]` solely to make the carrier-dependent `spechtModuleℂ_ρ` elaborate, exposing the entire bundled implementation to downstream reduction.

summary: The complex Specht module unnecessarily exposes its implementation body even though an opaque defining equation can provide the required dependent API.
